name: eep-realworld-simulation
description: Current web (HTML) vs EEP live demo — Next.js provider + deterministic Google ADK agents

scripts.install:agent: cd agent && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m playwright install chromium
scripts.setup: npm run install:provider && npm run install:agent
scripts.demo: npm run setup && cd agent && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python run_demo.py
